question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Before preservationists could put a stop to it, he and other looters had raided and destroyed __**precious**__ relics buried at the site.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"precious"** means something that is of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly. (बहुमूल्य)

 
 
• **Example: **Gold and diamonds are considered** precious** metals and stones.
 
 
 
• **"Defective" **refers to something that is not working properly or is flawed; it is the opposite of being valuable. (दोषपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The manufacturer recalled the **defective **products from the market.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'precious' **is **'defective'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Important **(महत्वपूर्ण): Of great significance or value.

 
 
• **Example:** It is **important** to stay hydrated during the summer.
 
 
 
• **Pet **(पालतू जानवर): A domesticated animal kept for companionship or pleasure.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a** pet** dog that she loves dearly.
 
 
 
• **Dear** (प्रिय): Regarded with deep affection; cherished by someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He wrote a letter to his **dear** friend.
